title: The Slowly Shrinking Answer
prompt:
**Scenario.** You can afford to pay c coins to increase a parameter x by 1, and the objective f(x) is provably non-increasing in x. The cost budget is huge (10^18). What is the intended family?

**Which approach is the best fit? The program only needs to print the letter.**

**A)** Simulate incrementing x one by one until the budget runs out

**B)** Binary search the largest affordable x, since f is monotone

**C)** DP over budget amounts

**D)** Greedy: spend everything immediately

tests.name: answer
tests.hint: Monotonicity of f makes binary search over x valid: O(log budget) instead of simulating 10^18 steps.
